instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure FastAPI backend at /backend endpoint includes endpoints POST /api/bookings, GET /api/bookings, PATCH /api/bookings/{id}/status, and notification triggers.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling using @studio-freight/lenis or custom requestAnimationFrame Lenis script.
Apply all images directly from the image_urls map above into portfolio galleries, service previews, and hero spotlights.
Ensure header/navbar has backdrop-blur-xl with dark background (never transparent) to satisfy readability rules.
Verify all interactive buttons, inputs, links, and cards include data-testid attributes.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Do not create basic white centered layout. Follow dark luxury editorial style with generous spacing (py-32), high contrast typography, fine hairline borders, and champagne gold accents.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_universal_transition: Never use transition: all. Use targeted CSS transitions like transition-colors duration-300 or transition-transform duration-500.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_rule: Maintain APCA contrast compliance. Set clear text colors on hover states (e.g. hover:text-black hover:bg-amber-400).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attributes: All key elements MUST include data-testid in kebab-case.
